_comment: Generated by scripts/difficulty/report.py. Boards the calibration could not bring on target, graded: `blocked` cannot be played at all (every cell has an indistinguishable twin, so the win rate is a coin flip per mine at any density), `warn` is playable but materially harder than its difficulty promises. Rows that missed the tolerance by less than 8% are not listed -- that is an ordinary board, not an unfair one. Both front-ends read this.
